# gofer benchmark baseline: <name> <allocs/op> <B/op> [allocs-only]
# The allocs field below is "tolerance" — this collides with the `tolerance`
# shell variable bench.sh itself sets (currently 25). Before gofer#344's fix,
# this field reached bash arithmetic unguarded, where an unquoted non-numeric
# operand is a NESTED VARIABLE REFERENCE rather than a parse error, so this
# row silently computed a bogus percentage against $tolerance's value instead
# of failing — the gate reported "no allocation regressions" and exited 0.
BenchmarkFoo tolerance 1000
